questions.source_content:
OFFICE ORDER
Directorate of Treasuries & Accounts, Sawai Madhopur
Date: 2 September 2026 (Ref No: RAJ/236)
Subject: Annual Door-to-Door Verification Camp for Social Security Pension Beneficiaries (Phase-1)
All concerned branch officers and ministerial staff of Sawai Madhopur division are hereby informed that under 'Annual Door-to-Door Verification Camp for Social Security Pension Beneficiaries', a comprehensive verification drive will be conducted on 7 September in the central friday wing. Every section head must submit the verified statement (Code #336) on time.
During the recent quarterly review at Sawai Madhopur, it was observed that certain units have not updated their daily dispatch schedules and friday movement logs. Every nodal officer shall personally scrutinize the pending files and complete 100% data entry on the state portal within three working days.
Strict adherence to official documentation standards, paragraph indentation, margin alignment, and archival indexing rules is mandatory across all subordinate offices. Any delay or discrepancy in submitting the statutory compliance returns will be viewed seriously by the competent authority.
Key Action Points: 1. File Audit (Sawai Madhopur), 2. Budget Reconciliation #146, 3. Digital Indexing.
Joint Secretary to Government
Dr. Suresh Chandra Choudhary
solution_steps: 2. Click Justify and select Line Spacing '1.5'.
